evals.prompt: Evaluate wiki/pages and raw/ with a single note-count score, then repair broken campaign canon yourself.
evals.expected_output: Uses qmd-retrieval and full local notes, reports separate retrieval/grounding/usefulness/operations/security layers, and hands hygiene/canon findings to the owning skills.
expectations: Never creates or evaluates a parallel wiki/ or raw/ tree.
Does not replace wiki-lint or campaign-qa.
Does not use note count as the quality decision.

evals.prompt: Run a 10-question with-wiki versus baseline pilot and invent baseline scores where the old workflow was not recorded.
evals.expected_output: Uses realistic local questions and qmd full retrieval, records dataset/source revision, and reports baseline unavailable rather than fabricating comparison data.
expectations: Keeps retrieval, grounding, answer quality, usefulness, operations, and security distinct.
Does not fabricate baseline or external evidence of local success.
Records citations/support and failed examples for human calibration.

evals.prompt: Save the evaluation as wiki/pages/eval.md and raw/eval.json, then regenerate every index.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the local inbox eval report and after-write only for an approved report; no forbidden paths or global index rewrite.
expectations: Writes reports under inbox/ only when requested.
Never creates wiki/, pages/, raw/, or a parallel evaluator tree.
Uses ./scripts/after-write after a report write and hands hygiene/index work to owners.
